title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: a package-less row at a holder's exact address answers one thing on every read and in every hydration state: declined for a sealed type, refused with two holders for an overlay type (ADR-0150 D4, ADR-0126 Regime C)
body:

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgRMD13a1o44xJemeSUCcHH1)_

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：一条没有绑定包的存储行（包外行）在某个包的精确地址（`?package=X`）上，现在每个读出口、每个加载状态都给同一个答案：可覆盖类型（email_template、dashboard、report）两个持有者时 409 并列出所有持有者；封闭类型（action、agent、page、hook、job、queue 等）一律不采用这条行，返回该包自己的定义。
- 补齐的出口：草稿读（`state=draft`）、草稿预览、layered 读及其 draft 层、按包列表的草稿预览，此前都在判断之前就返回了包外行。
- 也修了加载器：列表读或启动加载时，它曾按"第一个持有该名字的包"借用信封，把包外行塞进那个包的槽位，于是读一次列表后同一地址的答案就变了；现在不再借，封闭类型的包外行根本不登记。
- 为什么：ADR-0150 D4 与 ADR-0126 Regime C；专题裁决 6817768147 按类型类别定了答案（封闭类型拒收，可覆盖类型按 D4）。
- 风险：只改读的应答与注册表加载，不改存储；三个第一方应用没有被两个包同时持有且带包外行的名字，仓库内应答不变。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts -t 32568`，预期 29 例全过。需要你做的：无，席位审查并落地。

Fixes #32568

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — reads that served now refuse (an overlay type's package-less draft of a two-holder name: 200 → 409; a sealed type's package-less draft: 200 → no draft), and reads that refused now serve the holder's own item (a sealed type's package-less registry copy and its layered read at a holder's exact address: 409 → 200 own). No export changes.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` and `content/docs/**` teach no exact, draft or layered read of a package-less row of a name a package holds; the prescription ships in the refusal text and the FROM → TO below.

`Metadata-protocol: none` because nothing an author writes changes: the change is which item an exact read serves or refuses and what the read-side hydrator registers; stored metadata is read exactly as before. Same reading as #32407 (PR #32566), which the seat accepted.

## What changes

The card's four locations, plus the epic's location 5, measured at PR #32566's head `238b9ee69` first (red file: 26 of the 29 new pins fail there, 3 CONTROLs pass).

Epic ruling 6817768147 (location 4, answer A by type class): a **sealed** type's package-less row (`isSealedManagedItem`: artifact-backed, not one of the five overlay types) is declined on every read at a holder's exact address, and the holder's own item is served; an **overlay** type keeps D4 (409 with two holders, served with one). The bare two-holder read keeps #32244's 409. The hydrator never borrows an envelope through a package-less `lookupArtifactItem`.

- `protocol-exact-qualifier.ts`: three module helpers (not exported): `declinesPackageLessRowAt` (a package-scoped type other than `flow` whose stored row the plain read declines), `isPackageLessRow`, and `declinedCopyReplaced` (a package-less registry copy of a declined name at an exact address is replaced by the holder's own artifact; with two holders of the bare name the read stays refused).
- `protocol-meta-item-reads.ts` (`readMetaItem`): the strict draft read and the preview judge the address as the active read does (location 1). The active read runs `declinedCopyReplaced` before `exactQualifierItem` (location 4, state 3). A package-scoped refusal raised inside the draft and preview `try` blocks is rethrown instead of being wrapped as `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`.
- `protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts`: a sealed type's package-less stored row is no layer at the address (`overlay: null`, `effective` the holder's own); the `draft` layer is judged like the plain draft read (location 3).
- `protocol-meta-list-reads.ts`: the scoped list's previewed drafts drop a withheld or declined package-less draft.
- `protocol-registry-hydration.ts` (`hydrateOverlayIntoRegistry`, location 4 state 2 and the one-holder flip): a package-less row of a sealed type is not registered; a copy a save registered before the package arrived is healed through the one heal walk (`restoreArtifactRegistryView`, #23198), as a known package-less row (#32366's binding `null`). The envelope lookup names the row's package, or the bare name's sole holder, or nothing with two holders (it used to take the FIRST holder).
- Location 2 (`hook`, `job`, `queue`, `sharing_rule`, `assignment_rule`): all five are sealed, so the same `declinedCopyReplaced` declines their environment item at each holder; no one-holder rule is added.
- `flow` is left out of every new decline: its package-less tenant row registers as it is (#20913, #21002), and its pair slots are #31696 / #32552's.

### Location 5 (#32552 F1, folded in by the epic 07:46Z)

Not covered. Reproduced on this tree: the flow execution list still carries `alpha:OVERRIDE-beta` (alpha first) and `beta:OVERRIDE-alpha` (beta first). It is the bare flow slot of two bound `.custom` pair rows (`incomingTakesStoredFlowSlot`), not a package-less row, so this hydrator change does not reach it. It is carried by #32613 (the two-holder override slots card).

## FROM → TO

Two holders `alpha`, `beta` ship the name; one package-less `sys_metadata` row (or its registry copy) of it.

| Read at `?package=<holder>` | Type class | FROM | TO | Clause-② arm | Pin |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `?state=draft`, `?preview=draft`, `?layers=true` `draft` layer | overlay, two holders | 200 the package-less draft at both | 409 `ambiguous-in-closure` naming both | narrowing | `overlay type, two holders: the strict draft read, the preview and the layered draft layer refuse 409` |
| scoped list with drafts previewed | overlay, two holders | the package-less draft listed at both | the holder's own | narrowing | same |
| `?state=draft` / `?preview=draft` / layered `draft` | sealed, one or two holders | 200 the draft | 404 no draft / the active item / `null` | narrowing | `sealed type (action), two holders and one: the package-less draft is declined` |
| active read, environment item in the bare slot | `hook` `job` `queue` `sharing_rule` `assignment_rule`, two holders | 200 the environment item at both | 200 the holder's own | narrowing | `<type>: the environment's item … declined at both exact addresses` ×5 |
| active read after the read-side hydrator (an unscoped list read, boot, write-through) | sealed, two holders | 200 the stored row as the FIRST holder's own; the other 200 own | 200 own at both | narrowing | location 4 `after the read-side hydrator` ×2 orders × `action`, `queue` |
| active read, bare-slot copy stamped `''` / `sys_metadata` | sealed, two holders | 409 naming both | 200 own at both | none (the row is still never served; the holder's own item is) | location 4 `bare-slot copy stamped …` ×2 stamps ×2 orders ×2 types |
| `?layers=true`, stored package-less row | sealed, two holders | 409 naming both (#32407) | 200, `overlay: null`, `effective` own | none (as above) | every location 4 state |
| active and bare read after the hydrator | sealed, one holder | 200 the stored row | 200 the holder's own | narrowing | `<type>, one holder: the stored row is declined before and after the read-side hydrator` |
| active read, environment item of `agent` / `skill` / `app` (the #31699 env-item loop) | sealed, one holder | 200 the environment item | 200 the holder's own | narrowing | #31699 loop now covers `dashboard`, `report` |
| registry after the read-side hydrator | overlay, two holders | the row laid into the first holder's slot | the first holder's slot keeps its own; reads 409 as before | none | `overlay type (email_template), two holders: 409 … before and after` |

Unchanged, pinned as CONTROLs: an overlay type with one holder serves its package-less row and draft on every exit, and the hydrator still lays it in under that holder's envelope; the bare read of a two-holder `action` keeps #32244's 409 before and after the hydrator; an overlay type's two-holder active read stays 409 before and after the hydrator.

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts`: new describe `[#32568] …` (29 cases): locations 1 and 3 (overlay two holders, overlay one holder CONTROL, sealed one and two holders); location 2 (five types); location 4 (`action` and `queue` × both registration orders × four states: stored, after the read-side hydrator, bare-slot `''`, bare-slot `sys_metadata`; one-holder before/after; the bare-read CONTROL; `email_template` two holders; overlay one-holder CONTROL). Existing #31699 and #32407 cases that pinned a sealed type's old answer now pin the ruling's (agent/skill/app → `dashboard`/`report` in the env-item loop; the three-stamp and layered `action` cases expect the holder's own and `overlay: null`; the `email_template` two-holder layered 409 kept).
- `packages/objectql/src/protocol-registry-shadow.test.ts`, `protocol-boot-hydration-scoped.test.ts`: two tests that pinned the hydrator's graft of a sealed `app`/`page` package-less row now pin that the package's own definition and envelope stay.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.lookup-artifact-item-call-sites.test.ts`: the census rows for the hydrator's lookup (it names a package now) and the new `declinedCopyReplaced` lookup.
- Red first at `238b9ee69`: 26 of 29 new pins fail, the 3 CONTROLs pass.
- Ablation: `protocol-registry-hydration.ts` alone back to `238b9ee69` turns 9 red (every after-hydrator pin, the one-holder flips, the `email_template` slot pin, and the two rewritten objectql tests); restored, 207/207 green (measured at `191cd2fa`, before the merges).

## Gates

Final head `82ccc8c2c` (origin/main `88282a788` merged in, never rebased; #32566 landed as `279f5592`). +475 / -59 over 10 files.

- `dispatch-gates --commands` on the 10 changed paths: 69 families, all exit 0. On the first pass `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` exited 3 on the shallow clone (re-run exit 0 after `git fetch origin 621a4876…`) and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 before a full `turbo run build` (re-run exit 0); every later pass was 69 × exit 0. `dispatch-gates --ran`: 69 derived, 69 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN (exit 0).
- `check-adr-0087-registration`: the changeset's `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` is accepted (it declares `Metadata-protocol: none`, not `narrowed`).
- `pnpm lint`: exit 0.
- Typecheck (`NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192`): `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` 0, `@objectstack/objectql` 0, `@objectstack/cli` 0. It caught one thing the suites did not: #32366 added a `packageId` parameter to `restoreArtifactRegistryView`; the hydrator now passes `null` (the row is known to be package-less).
- Suites: `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` 337 files / 22786 passed; `@objectstack/objectql` 590 / 12511 passed; `@objectstack/cli` 634 / 7908 passed.
- Dogfood battery (`@objectstack/dogfood`, full): 455 files / 3816 passed / 42 skipped, 0 failed.

## Acceptance notes

- One-holder reading: the ruling says a sealed package-less row is declined "on every read at a holder's exact address"; that is applied with one holder too (draft, preview, layered), not only with two.
- Location 2 needed no one-holder rule: the five types are sealed, so the sealed decline answers them.
- New findings, not folded in (measured on this tree):
  - A sealed type's stored row bound to a holder that is not a declared override is declined by the plain read while only stored, but its registry copy (state 3 with that holder's id) is served.
  - The bare read (no `?package=`) of a sealed type the registry reads by package, one holder, state 3, serves the registry copy.
  - `os migrate stored-references` still lists a sealed type's package-less rows as needing a package; they are declined, not ambiguous.
